description: This file contains shell script code for testing Git operations related to branch overwriting, worktrees, fetching, rebasing, and error states. It defines multiple tests with specific scenarios to verify behaviors in Git's handling of refs, worktrees, and related conflicts.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit, used in setting up test scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting failure.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: test_editor_unchanged
methods.description: Verifies that the editor environment remains unchanged.

methods.name: set_cat_todo_editor
methods.description: Configures the editor to cat the todo list for rebase operations.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of testing script execution.
